verdict.rationale: Cursor documents multiple isolation mechanisms relevant to safe testing: Cloud Agents run in isolated VMs with encrypted, temporary repo copies (cursor-supp-cloud-agents, cursor-supp-privacy-governance), Worktrees keep the main checkout untouched during agent work (cursor-supp-worktrees), agents can spin up dev servers and click through UI flows to verify changes before opening a PR (cursor-docs-28), and Run Modes sandbox shell commands where possible (cursor-supp-run-modes). However, none of this is framed explicitly around separating sandbox vs. production data (e.g. staging DBs, seeded test data, or production-data masking) — it's about isolated git/VM execution rather than data environments, and the docs themselves caveat that 'Auto-review is not a security boundary.' Missing for 10: explicit production-vs-sandbox data separation, staging environment/test-data provisioning features, and independent confirmation that production data is never reachable during agent testing.
